EXTRAORDINARY

This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

PG 7051 - 05 (03/2025)

(Published by Authority) PART IV (B) - LOCAL GOVERNMENT Local Government Notifications Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha Declaration as a Development Area

AS the Honourable Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province has publish in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2316/20 dated 2022 January 24 to be read with the Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, "Orders on the preparation of plans and posting of notices showing the list of names of the roads and lanes maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province" according to the assigned to the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province and it is hereby published for the public that it has been decided under Decision No. 16 of 16.01.2025 and as Section 9(3) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act No.15 of 1987, that all said road and lanes mentioned in the schedule below shall be owned by Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha. If the party claiming the land considers that any road or lane mentioned in the said schedule is entering in any land or part of any land it is hereby announced that action should be taken to file a case in the competent court before expiry of a period of three month from the date of the said notification in order to prove right to the land. It is further informed that every road and lane mentioned in the said schedule, for which no such case has been filed before the expiry of the said period of three months, shall be deemed to be a road or lane owned by the Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha. R. K. Kൺඉංඅൺ Jൺ඀ൺඍඁ Gඎඇൺඍඁංඅൺ඄ൺ, Secretary and the Implementation Officer carrying out the functions, Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha. Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha, 27th February, 2025.
